languages_frameworks: vanilla JS + Cytoscape-style graph front end

implemented_capabilities.capability: Binary disassembly ingestion into a function/memory call graph in FalkorDB
implemented_capabilities.notes: Uses real Capstone disassembly (ELF PT_LOAD handling, call targets, RIP-relative memory refs) and UNWIND batch writes; the /api/upload path only inspects the first 8 KB and 120 instructions and then registers a canned target config.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Multi-hop memory provenance and call-chain queries (WRITES -> GlobalMemory, CALLS*1..6, shortestPath)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parameterised Cypher tools over Function/GlobalMemory nodes incl. CALL algo.pageRank with a degree-count fallback; detect_subsystem_clusters is a simple degree-threshold heuristic labelled as role clustering.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Episodic memory of candidate reconstructions and test outcomes
implemented_capabilities.notes: Writes Candidate nodes (RECONSTRUCTS->Function) and PASSED / FAILED_ON {diff,timestamp} edges to TestCase; fetch_failure_memory reads prior failures to feed the next prompt.

implemented_capabilities.capability: LLM function reconstruction with graph context
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real Gemini call when a key is set, but the no-key/failure fallback _synthesize_from_graph_context returns pre-written correct implementations (progressive tax brackets, lunar throttle curve) or a stub returning True, i.e. canned answers presented as graph-grounded synthesis.

Billing path genuinely exec()s the candidate and compares against vectors (test_truthful_execution.py). For telemetry/pacman/snake/keygen/lunar the has_graph_memory flag selects a pre-baked pass or fail branch (e.g. zeroed CRC table when False), so the 'graph vs flat LLM' contrast is largely scripted.

Single-iteration (max_iterations=1) orchestration; TARGET_CONFIGS embeds hand-written disassembly, decompiled and reconstructed C for each demo target, and the stream inserts sleep delays between events for theatrical pacing.
Described as an 'authentic in-memory Cypher engine' but is substring matching on known query text with a hard-coded FlightTelemetry struct; any other Cypher returns an empty list.
Substring check of allowed symbols in code; 'unresolved' is never populated and status is VERIFIED if any symbol appears, so it does not detect hallucination.
Snake, Space Invaders, lunar-lander and telemetry downlink simulators used only for the visual demo; synthesized candidates are hot-loaded into them.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Program, Function {name,address,signature,pseudocode,raw_asm}, GlobalMemory {address,label,data_type}, Struct/StructField, Candidate {id,function_name,source_code,version,status,timestamp}, TestCase. Edges: CALLS, READS, WRITES, EXERCISES, RECONSTRUCTS, PASSED, FAILED_ON {diff,timestamp}, HAS_FIELD. Multigraph isolation per target via select_target_graph (name sanitised with a regex). Cypher uses $params, UNWIND batch ingestion, variable-length CALLS*1..6, shortestPath, and FalkorDB CALL algo.pageRank. No APOC/GDS. WARNING: POST /api/cypher passes caller-supplied Cypher straight to graph.query (write-capable).
algorithms: Capstone x86-64 disassembly with ELF PT_LOAD discovery and call/RIP-relative memory reference extraction (topology_agent.py:ingest_binary)
PageRank over CALLS with degree-based fallback (cypher_tools.py:compute_function_pagerank)
Differential parity percentage over test vectors (differential.py:run_tests)
backend_interfaces: No actual MCP server: 'mcp_tools' is a Python module of functions
frontend_interfaces: Static JS front end (frontend/app.js, graph_engine.js, index.html) with graph visualisation, SSE agent timeline and in-browser games
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Three named agents (Topology, Reconstruction, Supervisor) coordinated by a generator pipeline emitting typed events; FalkorDB used as episodic memory (Candidate / FAILED_ON) fed back into prompts via fetch_failure_memory, though the pipeline runs a single iteration; no persistent cross-session learning beyond graph writes.
tests_present: backend/tests/test_truthful_execution.py (1 real pytest function exercising billing differential execution) plus 5 verify_*.py scripts and backend/test_*.py smoke scripts that need live FalkorDB/Gemini. No CI. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: backend/app.py:220-231 - POST /api/cypher executes arbitrary caller-supplied Cypher via falkor_client.query (write-capable, unauthenticated); full graph read/write/delete exposure
backend/harness/differential.py:760-761 - compile()+exec() of LLM/candidate Python in a bare dict scope (builtins available); arbitrary code execution if candidate text is influenced by an attacker
backend/app.py:417-424 - exec() of synthesized candidate code hot-loaded into the live game engine
backend/harness/compiler.py:~70 - subprocess.run of gcc/clang on LLM-generated C source written to disk (arguments fixed; source untrusted); 15 s timeout but no sandbox
backend/agents/reconstruction_agent.py:280 - Gemini API key sent as URL query parameter (?key=), so it can appear in logs/proxies
backend/app.py:761-800 - unauthenticated file upload, 2 MB cap, first 8 KB disassembled; low risk but no content-type or auth checks
backend/mcp_tools/falkor_client.py:52-56 - graph name derived from target name sanitised with re.sub, acceptable
No hard-coded secrets: .env.example contains placeholders only
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps generic binary / code reverse-engineering demos and graph-grounded LLM synthesis patterns; the CALLS/WRITES provenance query overlaps lineage/provenance traversal in other repos.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - Candidate to TestCase PASSED/FAILED_ON edges with timestamps give a small episodic verification lineage, but there is no supersession, temporal validity, dependency invalidation or approval gating.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small parameterised Cypher helpers for producer-of-state provenance and a candidate/test episodic-memory pattern; everything else is demo scaffolding.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB; Capstone only for the ingestion path; Gemini key for synthesis

strategy_rationale: Most of the apparent capability is scripted demo behaviour (canned fallback code, flag-driven pass/fail, game simulators) and the API exposes unauthenticated arbitrary Cypher plus exec() of generated code, so only the provenance query idea and the candidate/test episodic memory shape are worth borrowing.
